snippets.title: Narrower isolating intervals
snippets.description: Tighten the largest allowed interval width to one millionth. Exact rational roots stay point intervals; irrational roots get longer endpoints.

snippets.title: Cubic with fractional coefficients
snippets.description: Replace the coefficient list (descending powers, exact fractions) with a cubic.

templates.title: Irrational roots of x^2 - 2
templates.description: Isolate the two real roots of x^2 - 2 to width 1/1000. Coefficients are exact fractions in descending powers.
templates.requires: Configure an isolated Python with SymPy 1.14.0.

templates.title: Repeated exact roots
templates.description: (x-1)^3 (x+2)^2 (x^2+1): exact point roots with multiplicities 3 and 2 and a complex pair.
templates.requires: Configure an isolated Python with SymPy 1.14.0.

templates.title: Polynomial with no real roots
templates.description: x^4/2 + 3 has four complex roots; the verifier proves the real-root count is zero.
templates.requires: Configure an isolated Python with SymPy 1.14.0.
